_readme: Saga fixes for Tracker's d69115c replay, items 3-5. No numbers, no new mechanics.

item3_meeting_replies._note: Choice texts in slice-1.json that now answer the cat's question, so the card reads as a finished exchange. If the result card still repeats the question beat above the reply, Flint should drop beat speech from eventResult and keep only the reply plus summary.
item3_meeting_replies.slice.meeting.loner/greet.text: “Just me,” you say. {catName} looks past you one more time, then gives a short nod. “Then it's two of us on one trail. That'll do.”
item3_meeting_replies.slice.meeting.highcrag/introduce.text: You give your name and wait. {catName} repeats it once, slowly, as if setting it somewhere safe. “Then we need not be strangers.” The path between you stays clear.

item4_scent_openers._note: Replaces the single scent-sign-v1 'opener' with a list. Pick one by (day + region index) % length, and never use the same one two days running. Plain text, no tokens.
openers: You lower your nose to the ground and breathe in slowly, sorting this place out scent by scent.
You stop, open your mouth a little, and let the air roll over your tongue. This place has a story, and you start reading it.
You work slowly along the ground, nose low, stopping at every stone and stem that someone else has touched.
The wind shifts and brings you something. You turn into it, eyes half closed, and pull the scents apart one by one.
You find a rubbing post and a scuffed patch of earth beside it, and you settle in to read what's been left there.

item5_let_watch.presence.hunt.let_watch: You go on eating. {name} stays put and watches every bite, until there's nothing left but bones. Then {name} stands, gives you one long look you can't read, and pads away without a word.

item2_card_words._note: Words for result cards and the result line; the numbers stay on the meters only. Pick by the signed delta. {catName} is the cat.

affinity.gain_small (+1..+5): {catName} seems a little warmer toward you.
affinity.loss_small (-1..-5): {catName} seems a little cooler toward you.

hunger.small (+1..+15): You've taken the edge off your hunger.
